title: $hp$-adaptive trees for graph signal approximation
summary: Tree-encoded partitionings of graphs are fundamental tools for the decomposition and approximation of graph signals. For the efficient approximation of such graph signals, we develop strategies based on $hp$-refinement by combining domain decomposition with an improved local approximation using polynomials of higher degree. In this way, from a given graph partitioning tree, a more efficient subtree is extracted in which the cost of the signal approximation is considerably reduced by still maintaining the same total error.
